categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Matches the Docs label and directly updates 21 release note snippet files alongside developer-notes.md.
categories.rationale: Adds missing PR numbers and updates a version reference across draft release note snippets to assist release compilation. These cosmetic and organizational cleanups to draft notes carry low urgency for reviewer attention.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Extends the Rust test runner doc linter in test/lint/test_runner/src/lint_docs.rs to enforce PR numbers on snippet files.
categories.rationale: Adds a simple doc linter check to ensure snippet files cite PR numbers. While useful for preventing omissions, it is a minor linter addition that does not impact test framework stability or catch functional code regressions.
